phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, both sides have an unknown army composition, but you are investing heavily in technology. Production is moderate.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate once you have scouted the opponent's army composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize tech and economy, increase production, keep army flexible, and scout for adaptation.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your technology and economy while increasing production. Maintain flexibility to adapt to scouting.
phase_policies.title: Early Tech Focus with Flexibility
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single tech path without scouting information; avoid neglecting production growth while teching.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 240-360 seconds, you have a ground army with Zealots, while the opponent may show ground (Zealots/Stalkers) or air (Void Rays). Production and tech are heavy.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have scouted the opponent's army composition or if they move out.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Continue ground production, increase economy, add anti-air if needed, and scout for transitions.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen your ground army and increase economy. If the opponent shows air, add anti-air units such as Stalkers or Phoenixes. Maintain scouting to identify the opponent's tech path.
phase_policies.title: Ground Macro with Anti-Air Contingency
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single ground unit type without support; avoid neglecting anti-air if the opponent shows air.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 420-540 seconds, the opponent may show ground (Zealots, Sentries, Warp Prisms) or air (Void Rays). You have a ground army with Zealots and a strong economy.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you need to respond to harass.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground strength, add Sentries for defense, add anti-air or transition to air if needed, and keep economy strong.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army and economy. If the opponent uses Warp Prisms, add Sentries for defense and detection. If the opponent has Void Rays, prioritize anti-air units and consider transitioning to air.
phase_policies.title: Ground Defense with Sentry Support or Air Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air if the opponent has air; avoid staying passive against a massing air army.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600 seconds, the opponent may show ground (Stalkers, Sentries, Warp Prisms, Immortals) or air (Zealots, Stalkers, Void Rays). You have a mixed ground/air army with Zealots and Void Rays or Stalkers and Carriers.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you need to respond to a specific threat.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain mixed army, upgrade, keep economy strong, and adapt to opponent's composition.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your mixed army, focusing on upgrades and maintaining a strong economy. If you have Void Rays, consider adding more for air superiority. If you have Carriers, continue building them and supporting units.
phase_policies.title: Mixed Army Upgrades and Air Superiority
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect upgrades or economy while focusing on army composition; avoid overcommitting to one unit type without support.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
